# How Do I Reduce Paperwork for Farm Managers With Mobile Forms?


You reduce paperwork by replacing notebooks and loose sheets with short mobile forms for the most frequent records, such as activities, inputs, harvest loads, and observations, so data enters the system in the field and reports are built from it. On **Jestor** , this runs through **Forms** connected to your tables and dashboards.


Farm managers often spend evenings typing notes into spreadsheets. The work is repetitive, errors creep in, and decisions wait for data that should have been available hours or days earlier.


## What paper-based farm management costs


- Evenings spent retyping handwritten notes
- Errors introduced during transcription
- Decisions delayed by late information
- Notebooks lost or damaged
- Reports that take days to prepare


## How mobile forms reduce paperwork


- A few **forms** cover the most frequent records
- Workers fill them in from the field in under a minute
- Data goes straight to the right table and dashboard
- Reports are produced from existing data


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Managers get time back for actual management
- Data is more accurate because it is recorded at the source
- Decisions can use today's information
- This scales from a small farm to a large operation


Notes on paper, retyped later Mobile forms feeding dashboards


Late, error-prone Immediate and accurate


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Do workers need technical skills?** No, forms can be very short and simple. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Does it work with weak connectivity?** Connectivity needs depend on your setup, so test it in your area first.


**Can I start with only one or two forms?** Yes, you can begin small and add forms over time.
